references.text: The theme of showing "deeds" (signs) to make the disciples see and believe has a parallel in John 2:11 at Cana, where Jesus performed his first sign so that his disciples believed.
Jesus later responds to accusations about his deeds by pointing to them as witnesses concerning him, a theme connected to the brothers' demand to see his "deeds" in John 10:32-33.
The interest in seeing Jesus' deeds leads many to ask whether he will come to the feast, a situation that mirrors the discussion in John 11:56 about whether he would come to Jerusalem.
